mentions.name: shifu
mentions.description: A pure POSIX shell framework for building powerful command-line interfaces. It provides argument parsing, subcommand dispatch, help string formatting, and tab completion for interactive shells, works across POSIX-based shells (ash, bash, dash, ksh, zsh), and ships as a single POSIX shell file with no dependencies.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on shifu (https://github.com/Ultramann/shifu), a pure POSIX shell framework to create powerful CLIs.
